Ibrance (palbociclib), CMS Part D 2025, from the quarterly companion 4ff7c618-4e40-483a-b390-c8a58c94fa15, row '2025 (Q1-Q4)': $2,618,976,627.82 over 20,018 beneficiaries = $130,831.08 a beneficiary. Ibrance is the right anchor because it matches on disease, class, partner and care setting: it is Pfizer's own CDK4/6 inhibitor, given with letrozole in first-line metastatic disease and bought under Part D. It was 70.2% of 11,557 first-line CDK4/6i+AI starts (Brufsky et al., Oncologist 2026, doi:10.1093/oncolo/oyag182). It has no adjuvant label, so its per-beneficiary figure is metastatic persistence (8.24 fills a beneficiary). Alternatives from the same file: Kisqali $101,190.62 (17,371) and Verzenio $101,458.11 (14,851). Both are diluted by adjuvant use and by fast growth (6.67 and 6.54 fills). Price per fill is within 5% across the class ($15,175 to $15,881), so the comparator choice is about persistence, not price. Cross-check: 0.5 x $130,831 = $65,416, which is 68% of Ibrance's 2027 Maximum Fair Price annualised ($7,871 per 30 days x 365/30 = $95,764, negotiated_prices). That sits inside the 65% to 167% spread gross_to_net.py measured, and leans conservative.

First, 84.3% of first-line patients start endocrine-based rather than chemotherapy-based treatment: chemotherapy alone or in combination was 15.7% of first lines among 3,244 women aged 65+ with HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer (Goyal et al., Breast Cancer Res Treat 2023, doi:10.1007/s10549-022-06845-4, SEER-Medicare 2010-2019). Second, 63.6% of first-line palbociclib patients took an aromatase inhibitor rather than fulvestrant, 573 of 901 (POLARIS, Tripathy et al., Oncologist 2024, doi:10.1093/oncolo/oyae291, US and Canada). The fulvestrant share stands in for the endocrine-resistant patients FOURLIGHT-3 excludes (recurrence within 12 months of adjuvant endocrine therapy). 0.843 x 0.636 = 0.536, about 34,850 of the 65,000 new metastatic patients a year. Not taken off: the trial also excludes any history of CNS metastases and visceral crisis. Goyal's cohort is 65 and over and partly pre-CDK4/6; POLARIS is palbociclib only.

column11: ANCHOR, the capture_anchor identity applied to Kisqali, the last CDK4/6 inhibitor to take first-line share, over its metastatic-only window. US revenue from Novartis 20-F inline XBRL (0001370368-24-000004, 0001370368-25-000004): 2021 $339mm, 2022 $472mm, 2023 $1,032mm, 2024 $1,678mm. Net per patient = 0.5 x CMS Part D per beneficiary (drug_demand: $83,131, $78,910, $81,614, $88,305). That gives a stock of 8,156, 11,963, 25,290 and 38,005. Stopping 36.52% a year, from ribociclib+AI real-world treatment duration of 18.3 months (Brufsky et al.): 0.5^(12/18.3) = 63.48% remain. New starts: 2022 = 11,963 - 8,156 x 0.6348 = 6,786; 2023 = 25,290 - 11,963 x 0.6348 = 17,696; 2024 = 38,005 - 25,290 x 0.6348 = 21,952. The pool is the annual endocrine-based first-line cohort, which is Kisqali's first-line label: 65,000 x 0.843 = 54,795. Capture: 12.4%, 32.3%, 40.1%. 2024 includes adjuvant starts from the September 2024 NATALEE approval, so 2023 is the clean year: 32.3%. CROSS-CHECK: the revenue basis counts 5.57 Kisqali patients per Part D beneficiary in 2023, against 2.07 for Ibrance in 2025 (41,428 / 20,018). Restated at Ibrance's ratio (stock 9,402 and 4,363), the 2023 capture is 12.1%. The convention probably fits Kisqali's net price or payer mix badly, and the revenue anchor overstates by up to 2.7x. MULTIPLE 0.4, A JUDGEMENT: 0.4 x 32.3% = 12.9%, which also sits at the beneficiary-basis capture. The case for more: FOURLIGHT-3 is the only CDK trial designed for superiority over CDK4/6 inhibitors, CDK4 selectivity spares neutropenia, and Pfizer held 70% of first-line starts. The case against: this is the fourth CDK agent into a crowded class; palbociclib is generic from 2027 (US basic patent RE47739, 2027-03-05 plus paediatric exclusivity to 2027-09-05), so payers will step through a generic; ribociclib has first-line overall survival data this drug will not have at launch; and oral SERDs (camizestrant) are moving into first line. The whole value rests on that result.
